data.name: Haibat
data.gender_notes: Haibat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'hafidh' meaning 'protector'. It also means 'beloved'. The name Haibat carries the meaning “Protected, Beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haibat usually hope their child will grow to embody protected, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents being protected and cherished by Allah.
data.etymology: Haibat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protected, Beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haibat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Haibat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Haibat originates from Arabic roots, signifying fear, reverence, or awe of Allah. It is mentioned in the Quran (Surah Al-Fath, Verse 26) in the context of the fear and reverence that disbelievers could not overcome. The name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing a profound sense of respect and fear towards the Almighty. It is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting a personality trait of piety and devotion

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, Haibat can represent the role of a guardian or protector in the larger sense, reminding us of Allah's role as a guardian and protector. The name can serve as a reminder to be present and protective of those around us, embodying the virtues of kindness, compassion and love. By carrying the name Haibat, one can strive to live up to its meanings and be a source of comfort, security and strength for those around them.
